data.name: VERITAS
data.detailed_description:
The Lowlands, one of the few remaining regions of Verita, is now surrounded by a dying world. Though robust enough to survive the ancient calamity, that not even the old gods withstood; its time is limited. Meet four unlikely companions as they traverse through dense forests, icy tundras, volcanic plains, and strange alien ruins that should have remained buried. Stop the corruption withering the Lowlands, and uncover what lies at its heart. 

VERITAS offers a linear narrative story driven metroidvania inspired by Terraria Calamity, and titles such as Blasphemous, Fear and Hunger, Miitopia, and Child of Light. Experience fast paced combat and rapidly switch between playable party members- or focus on one and release more devastating abilities.

Learn more about your party as they interact with this vibrant world in their own ways; and when the going gets rough and the nights get cold, find a place to settle down and unwind. Set up camp and interact with your party, learn more about who they are and deepen their bonds with each other.

Encounter and mingle with a vast array of characters from a variety of cultures as you travel through villages and countryside. Meet humble vagrants and nomads along the road, and stumble upon esoteric cultists that practice strange rituals in the woods.
